repairs.name: S4-NEW-01 — A tiny loop keeps its place.
repairs.originalError:
TEST FAILURE

The frame duplication, hold settings, and final frame selection were verified, but Undo and Redo did not restore the expected frame 1 durations.

Observations:
- The final timeline shows two frames: frame 1 at 100 ms and frame 2 at 200 ms; frame 2 is selected and the readout shows Frame 2 / 2.
- After the Undo sequence, frame 1 was reported at 125 ms rather than the expected 100 ms.
- After Redo, frame 1 remained at 100 ms rather than returning to 150 ms.

Dismiss first-run welcome with Skip setup if it appears; otherwise continue without inventing a welcome step.
Duplicate the selected frame using the timeline toolbar.
The timeline has exactly two frames; the duplicate is selected and visibly contains the same Bun artwork.
Set the selected second frame hold to 200 ms.
Select the first frame card.
Set its hold to 100 ms.
Select the second frame card.
The second hold is 200 ms; the first card shows 100 ms; the selected frame readout identifies frame 2 of 2 at this wide viewport.
Select the first frame card.
Set the active frame hold to 150 ms and blur the input.
The first card and active hold input show 150 ms; frame count remains two.
Click Undo last action exactly once.
The first frame hold returns to 100 ms; the second card still shows 200 ms and there are two frames.
Click Redo last action exactly once.
The first frame hold returns to 150 ms; the second card still shows 200 ms and there are two frames.
Select the second frame card.
The readout shows Frame 2 / 2 and its active hold remains 200 ms. All prior assertions must have been checked. Unsupported assertions are Blocked, not inferred passes.

repairs.name: S4-NEW-11 — A swatch knows which pot.
repairs.originalError:
TEST FAILURE

Shift-clicking a different palette swatch did not change the secondary color while preserving the primary color.

Observations:
- The primary was initially set to #EDE8F4.
- After the Shift-key attempt and selecting the #FFFFFF swatch, the primary displayed #FFFFFF and the secondary remained #C792DF.
- The canvas summary continued to show digest 6af29269. The right-click context-menu behavior was not tested.

Dismiss first-run welcome with Skip setup if it appears; otherwise continue without inventing a welcome step.
Open Colors from the primary well.

repairs.name: Save a drawing and reload the project in the same browser context
repairs.originalError:
TEST FAILURE

The reopened project retained the first frame’s red mark and both frame durations, but the required two-layer structure was not present in the verified state. Only “Base Layer” appeared in the Layers panel.

Observations:
- Frame 1 showed one red pixel on the transparent checkerboard; the page reported one painted pixel in #ff0000.
- The timeline showed frame 1 at 100 ms and frame 2 at 200 ms.
- The Layers panel showed only “Base Layer.”

originalSteps.description: Navigate to the studio
Use the welcome controls to enter the editor
Create a new drawing canvas
Name the project S4 Save Roundtrip; create two distinguishable frames with red and blue marks, holds of 100ms and 200ms, and two named layers.
Save the project
Reload the page in the same browser context
Reopen the saved project
Verify the same named project, two frames, two layer names and both 100/200ms holds survive the same-context reload. Persistent Undo is not required.
Verify each frame retains its own exact marked pixels and transparency after reloading, using rendered/raster observations or independently decoded exports.

clarifiedSteps.description: Navigate to the studio
Dismiss first-run setup only if it appears. Wait for restoration to be active before editing.
Create a new drawing canvas

Name the project S4 Save Roundtrip. In frame 1 retain its Base Layer and create a real red mark; commit its hold to 100 ms with Tab. Add a blank frame 2, commit its hold to 200 ms with Tab, add a second layer named Blue Mark in THAT frame and paint a real blue mark on it. Record each frame’s own layer identities/names/pixels: frame 1 has one Base Layer; frame 2 has Base Layer plus Blue Mark. Layers are per-frame, not a global list. Keep all baseline artwork and exact file/raster expectations.
Click Save now and wait for the actual Changes saved confirmation before leaving or reloading. Commit any layer-name input with Enter first.

Actually reload this same browser page/context, using the supported reload operation or Control+R. Merely reopening the current Projects row is not a reload. If reload or required observations are unavailable, keep that checkpoint Blocked.
Reopen the saved project

Select frame 1 explicitly: require its 100 ms hold, original Base Layer and original red mark. Then select frame 2 explicitly: require its 200 ms hold, BOTH Base Layer and Blue Mark, with the actual blue mark on Blue Mark. Compare each frame with its own original layer identities/names; do not search frame 1 for a layer created only in frame 2. Persistent Undo is not required.
Verify each frame retains its own exact marked pixels and transparency after reloading, using rendered/raster observations or independently decoded exports.
